notes.title: New Map: The Steel Nest
notes.content:
Build 18 is now live mainly featuring The Steel Nest, a dwelling in a snowy peak where slippy accidents can happen. This new map is now available for public testing, if you find any problem, make sure to report them.

Various extra fixes:
- Fixed an issue with some riddles/minigames in G.L.I.T.C.H. mode that made the game impossible to end.
- Improved a bit the performance for The Ellipse by removing some unused objects from memory.
- Fixed an error related to the 'line-stopping' minigame in which they could spawn in wrong positions.

Sorry for the delay, but as modes and features increase, the time to adapt a new map to those features also increases.

notes.title: Build 17 Update - Demo & Cosmetic Masks
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Added masks in the lobby's shop.
- Demo added to the game (full info below)
-Fixed an issue in Stalker mode in which the Stalker player couldn't see visual hints when an innocent makes noise while opening a door/firewall.
- Minigames/Riddles that have a next part, that next part position is now synced properly to all players.
- Related to previous, fixed another issue that happened in Deliasi Platform due to wrong references.
- Changed the holding item/weapon animation. Also, players can now actually see better if they're holding the camera.

Demo will be an experimental feature that will probably be temporary or something that is activated/deactivated depending on seasons or events.

Demo features:
- Demo players can join full-game player rooms with no restrictions respecting maps or modes. P.e. streamer's viewers can join the game by downloading the demo instead of having to share extra keys.

Demo disadvantages:
- Players hosting a room with a demo version will only have access to one map and two modes for now.
- Demo players have less priority over full-game players while connecting to server.
- Demo players can't access shop, mutagens, poses, etc. Their points will be saved if they decide to eventually get the full game's version.
- Demo players cannot connect to in-game voice chat (it uses extra bandwidth from the server)
- Demo players cannot see certain 'secrets'.

notes.title: Build 16 Update - Lockdown Update
notes.content:
- Implemented a new concept for Insidious mode: the **Area Lockdown**, when you click over a player's body, the rest of players will be confined in the area where the body was found for 60 seconds (may set this time as a lobby variable).
- Added an achievement for beating the Escape Room in 8 minutes or less.
- Fixed a critical issue with the new item drop system which allow players to basically clone items.
- Item selection and drop item wheel are now smoother, it will still have a future overhaul.
- Changed the highlight system, icons that appear when approaching a riddle/minigame or item will now shine instead.
- G.L.I.T.C.H. was supposed to respawn sooner when you closed a door/firewall on it but the behaviour wasn't working. Fixed.
- Fixed an issue in which score at the end of a G.L.I.T.C.H. match would not be properly displayed.
- Moved the Device Respawn Time option down in the Basic Settings blackboard since it is an Insidious only setting.
- Fixed a pipe collider and you could get into in Deliasi Platform.

notes.title: Build 15 Update - Escape Room
notes.content:
The first Escape Room is here! Players have 30 minutes to guess the data required to exit via collecting items and solving the riddles inside the room. While tested, this is a first public implementation so if you find any problem or issue make sure to report them.

Due to this new mode and items array progressively increasing, players can now drop items. (Some items are marked as critical and cannot be dropped, like the insta-disable device). I'll probably rework the inventory system so it is a bit smoother than the current one.

notes.title: Build 14 Update - Railgun Minigame
notes.content:
- Implemented a new minigame for Deliasi platform, use a railgun to destroy a group of drones!
- Deliasi Platform is available for public testing in G.L.I.T.C.H. mode.
- Fixed an issue in which a player's name would stay in the lobby's colors blackboard when disconnected.
- Implemented a behaviour for the G.L.I.T.C.H.: it will disguise as another player and covertly stop at riddles/minigames in an attempt to catch the players unaware.
- Fixed the UI issue in which icons would appear too small in certain resolutions. If there's any icon type I missed, report back to me.
- Trials/minigames highlight icons would sometimes appear in the wrong position for a frame, fixed.

New Escape Room mode is being developed, can't set a date yet but the deadline target is this month.

notes.title: Halloween Update: G.L.I.T.C.H. mode
notes.content:
G.L.I.T.C.H. is a single-player and cooperative new spooky mode against the AI which features a night version of The Ellipse (hence players are equipped with flashlights). 

Depending on support I'll prioritize adding more features to this mode and add a night version of Deliasi Platform for it! Feel free to report any issues or improvements you would like to see so I can tweak the AI parameters.

This is the first mode that can be enjoyed single-player, remember everything is better enjoyed with friends though. During November I'll start implementing a proper Escape Room mode which will allow both singleplayer and cooperative gameplay as well.

You can check latest news in the game's Discord: discord.gg/qspJ5C4u3K

notes.title: New Map: Deliasi Platform
notes.content:
https://i.postimg.cc/jdDhDRds/TAG-Deliasi-GIf.gif

Deliasi Platform has been released tonight for public testing. Since I want to check if it's possible to still release a new mode for Halloween I'm going to delay new trials/minigames for this map until November. I'm also thinking about delaying a bit the development of next map and implement a Escape Room mode for any player number (including singleplayer).

Feel free to report any issue or bug inside the game's Discord.

Changelog:
- New map: Deliasi Platform.
- Implemented a first iteration of Chinese localization. Localizations will be polished and checked over time since (excepting English and Spanish) I have no way to corroborate their quality but with a native speaker.
- Fixed a critical issue in the cleaning picture minigame (changes done to the lobby drawing minigame caused this) (uploaded as a hotfix)
- Changed the way in which inventory data is retrieved for a more efficient way in preparation for new maps.
- Corrected a small issue in the Ellipse which caused the 'line moving' last trial to sometimes don't spawn.
- Updated The Ellipse loading screen.

notes.title: Build 11 Update - EMP Device
notes.content:
Next week will hopefully feature the new map: Deliasi Platform. Here's this week changelog:

- Implemented the EMP Spike devices in insidious mode, for now the only item that can split players. Two of these devices must be set and a countdown of 100 seconds will start, if timer runs out insidious automatically wins and receives an extra of 200 points in disruption score. Players can still disable the first one if they see it before setting the second one.
- Added a small light inside gun cabinet so the pistol itself is a bit more visible.
- Fixed a moderate issue with network system which bugged a bit the footsteps sound of non-visible players (like when they approach from behind) and which made the invisible players walk-stutter a bit from the Stalker's point of view.
- Improved the values of some metallic textures in The Ellipse (were too dark).
- Implemented an auxiliary behavior for a case in which the 'Starting in' text would activate again when loading level (report if this happens again).
- Fixed an issue in which sometimes the message when a player would connect would not show the username.
- Fixed an issue in the 'secret area' in which if a player would crash or disconnect, the behavior to open the gate would bug.
- Implemented a behavior for the case in which host crashes while loading, a new host should be chosen and players would not get stuck in loading screen.
- Added a message for when player's inventory is full (a system to be able to drop non-critical items will be implemented soon)
- Added the opposite mutagen of helium voices (was already coded but not added)
- Smoke devices would always face upwards for all players (no random angle).
- Increased the default noise threshold from 10% to 20% in Stalker mode.

notes.title: Build 10 Update - The Gun Cabinet
notes.content:
These days the changes will arrive more sparingly since most of my time is going into building the new map but I'll try at least to give some patch/fix content every Tuesday (next week will feature the EMP Spike item)

Changelog:
- Implemented something which can either be good to hunt the insidious or an element of discord: the Gun Cabinet. The gun cabinet will require X amount of players (depends on playing number) in order to open and the last one interacting will get the gun inside, but make sure an innocent gets it before it's too late. It won't be possible to interact with the gun cabinet if the player is a projection.
- Added a first iteration of the French localization.
- Some interface textures that looked wrong in lower graphic settings has been excluded from optimization and should look right now (report if there's any I missed).
- Modified and improved the community's board.
- Fixed Kinetic Trap issue on item wheel selection (said 'Equip' while it's an 'use on select' item)
- Added more particle detail to the Kinetic Trap (more visible once active now), does damage faster to the player and disabling it will cause a 'fuse' visual and sound effect to show up.
- Stalker now has a 1000% integrity value, this is to prevent anyone being donkey enough to disable himself with traps.
- Added an extra layer of network security to game's listing system. 

In other news, there's a group of players that last week did a certain 'something' and accessed a secret area of the game, I'll progressively add content to do down there too.

notes.title: Build 09 Update - Kinetic Trap, Improvements and Fixes.
notes.content:
Build 09 is out though some changes were already available in hotfixes. The main feature is the Kinetic Trap. Deliasi Platform is advancing smoothly.

Build 09 changelog:
- Implemented a first iteration of the Kinetic Trap, a device that spawns in insidious' room and periodically receives the Stalker. If players step on it will produce an area of effect damage during 20 seconds, although it can be deactivated if perceived.
- Fixed an issue in lobby's drawing minigame in which the not painting players would receive a loop behaviour crash.
- A 'success' sound should now play when someone guesses the word in the drawing minigame.
- Implemented an option in Audio settings to alternate between voice Push to talk and Voice Detection.
- Reduced rain audio volume in central corridor in the Ellipse by a 20%.
- The top three poses in the shop are now free to get.
- Introduced an option in Audio settings to choose what microphone to use if the player has several connected.
- Lowest graphic option now decreases texture quality by -a lot-. Only use if you have serious performance issues, some UI textures will be corrected so they don't appear so blurry.
- Fixed an issue in which the game would not remember the last microphone set and player would have to set it manually in options.
- Fixed an issue in which if escape was pressed during control change the window would persist.

notes.title: Build 08 patch changelog
notes.content:
Starting to post version changelogs in Steam too since tomorrow is the game's soft release. I'm preparing a roadmap post with information for the remaining months of 2021.

Changelog:
- Added tips in loading screen.
- An issue in which keys re-assignation would reset when quitting the game has been fixed.
- An issue in which alive players could read projection text chat has been fixed.
- Players won't be able to fix stuff (open doors, etc) when in projection mode. This fixes the issue in Stalker mode in which audio cues would pop up for doors opened by projections (or ghosts).
- Some mutagens don't work in some modes, descriptions in shop now reference that.
- Fixed an issue in which match would not end if a host transfer occurred while ingame and no innocents or no insidious were left.
- Fixed an issue in which a player's footsteps could be heard after such player disconnected.
- Added a new mutagen that alters player's voice pitch for fun.
- Fixed a minor issue in which mouse cursor would still persist after escaping options (and required a click to hide).
- Smoke devices last a bit longer and the fog they produce is now denser.
